response.rationale: Order Line is one line item inside an order. Order is the whole aggregate. In A, execute takes an array of OrderLine values (lines: readonly OrderLine[]) and returns an Order, so the code shows one owning the other as a part. That makes them two related concepts, not one concept under two names.
